newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Chico's FAS remains at neutral.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Chico's FAS remains at neutral.

text.p: Dillon, Read & Co Inc said Wednesday it continues to rate Chico's FAS Inc as neutral, adding that it believes the specialty retailer is in the process of a turnaround under new management.

Chico's reported fiscal first quarter earnings of $0.13 a share, up from a Dillon, Read estimate of $0.10. Sales for the first quarter rose 7.5 percent from a year ago to $18.7 million. Dillon, Read had estimated a sales gain of 6.3 percent.
Dillon, Read also said it is raising its earnings estimate for the year ending January 31, 1998 to $0.33 from $0.30 to reflect first quarter performance.
Shares of Chico's FAS closed unchanged at 3-3/4.
